deadline.value: Otago sets no PhD application deadline and accepts applications at any time of the year.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for applying for PhD study at the University of Otago. You can apply at any time throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No fetchable official page mentions a Physics GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Under the university-wide PhD rule, applicants must first find a supervisor and a department before a formal application.
supervisor.quote: you will first need to find a supervisor and a department and then make a formal application

funding.value: All PhD students can apply for the University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship, which is assessed competitively each quarter after an invitation to apply.
funding.quote: All PhD students are able to apply for a Doctoral Scholarship when they have submitted an application to the PhD programme | Applications are assessed on a quarterly basis, usually around March, June, September and November of each year. | Most successful international scholarship applicants will have the most relevant grades

entry_route.value: PhD study generally requires a master's degree or a first-class or upper second-class honours degree in a relevant discipline.
entry_route.quote: PhD study generally requires completion of a master's degree or a first-class or upper second-class honours degree in a relevant discipline

notes: The physics PhD page (https://www.otago.ac.nz/physics/postgraduate/postgraduate-degrees/phd) is titled 'PhD, Department of Physics' in an otago.ac.nz search result but returns a Cloudflare 403 to the fetcher, so the department's own deadline, GRE, English and entry rules are unverified. Supervisor and funding come from university-wide AskOtago pages, not from the physics page. The scholarship assessment rounds are 'usually around March, June, September and November' with no year or date, so no time_sensitive date is set. The deadline is Rolling, from AskOtago's 'Apply for a PhD' article, which says there are no PhD deadlines. The doctoral scholarship page is blocked: https://www.otago.ac.nz/courses/scholarships/university-of-otago-doctoral-scholarship. The department's own PhD page (https://www.otago.ac.nz/physics/postgraduate/postgraduate-degrees/phd) is still blocked, so its GRE Subject, English and any department IELTS rule remain unverified and Not stated.
